function.name: dice_roll_probability
function.description: Calculate the probability of a specific sum appearing from rolling two dice. Unlike flip_coin_probability, which calculates the probability of a coin outcome, this calculates the probability of a sum from two dice.

desired_sum.description: The sum for which to calculate the probability.

n_rolls.description: Number of dice to be rolled. Default is 1

sides_per_die.description: Number of sides on each die.

function.name: flip_coin_probability
function.description: Calculate the probability of a specific outcome appearing from flipping a coin. Unlike dice_roll_probability, which calculates the probability of a sum from two dice, this calculates the probability of a coin outcome.

desired_outcome.description: The outcome for which to calculate the probability.

n_flips.description: Number of coins to be flipped. Default 1

function.name: shuffle_card_probability
function.description: Calculate the probability of a specific card appearing from a shuffled deck. Unlike dice_roll_probability, which calculates the probability of a sum from two dice, this calculates the probability of a specific card.

desired_card.description: The card for which to calculate the probability.

n_decks.description: Number of decks to shuffle. Default 1
